notes.title: Trading post
notes.content:
The [b]"Trading post"[/b] building has been added to the game.

In [b]"12 wave"[/b] this building will be opened.

In the first 8 maps, from "12 wave" will spawn [b]3 items[/b] on [b]random[/b] places in map.

Each item have own [b]4 places[/b] for spawn.

Places for spawn are [b]in buildings[/b].

Each location has a [b]33% chance[/b] to spawn.

Each item adds [b]2000 points[/b].

Random spawn of items is at the start of each new wave.

A player can carry only one item of each type.
